title: T10 — Project registers (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project Registers — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Risks

No project-owned risk row is recorded for T10; the live risks are the programme's R1–R14
(scope vs capacity, record theatre, instrument self-deception, transport, shared target,
register staleness, provenance, standard completeness, CI budget, evidence theatre, seed
quality and the quality of the V1 record itself). This section is an explicit absence, not an
omission.

## Issues

| Code | Issue | Status |
|---|---|---|
| U3-EXC-T10 | Out-of-sequence closure accepted as a retrospective exception (T10) | accepted |

## Assumptions

The cadence job runs on the estate's scheduler; the WIP slots and WSJF inputs are tenant rows,
not compiled constants; tranche-4's authorisation is recorded by the tr4 review, not by T10.

## Dependencies

T2 (the decision ladder); T1 (the plan-spine baseline contract); T4 (the coach card, except the
retro card); T11 (metrics); T12 (the one-organisation-loop acceptance).

## Benefits

T10 owns no benefit profile; the cadence is the delivery machinery the programme's B4/B5
benefits are reviewed against. The benefit status is carried by U6's profiles, not here.

## Changes

No project change row is recorded for this retrospective window. The acceptance travelled
through the tranche-4 authorisation and the project's approved baseline and charter gates
(`charter`, `baseline`, `closure`, `projects.close` — all approved, distinct approvers).
